block.notes: Creates a single block at the specified location.

cuboid.description: A solid rectangular box. Fills every block between two opposite corners.
cuboid.parameters: x1,y1,z1 (first corner), x2,y2,z2 (opposite corner), bid (block type)
cuboid.notes: Use for walls, floors, solid blocks. Coordinates can be given in any order.

wall.description: A wall of blocks extending in a specified direction.
wall.parameters: length, height, orientation (direction vector), ox,oy,oz (origin), bid (block type)
wall.notes: Orientation is a direction vector (dx, dy, dz) that determines the direction the wall extends from the origin. NORTH = (0, 0, -1), SOUTH = (0, 0,  1), EAST  = (1, 0,  0), WEST  = (-1, 0, 0), e.g. for North wall, orientation = (0, 0, -1) so dx = 0, dy = 0 and dz = -1. The wall will extend in a negative z direction from the origin ox, oy, oz. The wall will be built upwards in the y direction to the specified height.

emptyCuboid.description: A hollow rectangular box. Fills every block between two opposite corners, except for the interior.
emptyCuboid.parameters: xlength, zlength, height, ox,oy,oz (origin), bid (block type)
emptyCuboid.notes: Use for hollow structures like houses or rooms. The walls are 1 block thick.

pyramid.description: A stepped pyramid tapering to a point.
pyramid.parameters: size (base width), ox,oy,oz (base origin), bid (block type)
pyramid.notes: The pyramid is built upwards in the y direction, with each level being a smaller square than the one below it. If the pyramid has an odd size, the top level will be a single block. If the pyramid has an even size, the top level will be a 2x2 square.

floor.description: A flat surface of blocks at a specified height.
floor.parameters: x1, y, z1 (first corner), x2, z2 (opposite corner), bid (block type)
floor.notes: Creates a flat surface with a thickness of 1 block. The y coordinate specifies the height at which the floor is placed.

triangle.description: A triangle with a pointed apex, built in a chosen direction.
triangle.parameters: size (base width), orientation (north/south/east/west), ox,oy,oz (base origin), bid
triangle.notes: Size must be ODD for a clean pointed apex; even sizes give a flat top. Orientation is a direction vector (dx, dy, dz) that determines the direction the triangle extends from the origin. NORTH = (0, 0, -1), SOUTH = (0, 0,  1), EAST  = (1, 0,  0), WEST  = (-1, 0, 0), e.g. for North wall, orientation = (0, 0, -1) so dx = 0, dy = 0 and dz = -1. The triangle will extend in a negative z direction from the origin ox, oy, oz. The wall will be built upwards in the y direction to the specified height.

slope.description: A sloped surface of blocks, built in a chosen direction.
slope.parameters: length, height, orientation (direction vector), ox,oy,oz (origin), bid (block type)
slope.notes: Orientation is a direction vector (dx, dy, dz) that determines the direction the slope extends from the origin. NORTH = (0, 0, -1), SOUTH = (0, 0,  1), EAST  = (1, 0,  0), WEST  = (-1, 0, 0), e.g. for North slope, orientation = (0, 0, -1) so dx = 0, dy = 0 and dz = -1. Additionally px and pz are calculated (perpendicular direction for the slope). This is in the form px, pz = -dz, dx, e.g. for North slope, px = 1 and pz = 0. Therefore for a slope with a north orientation, the slope is extended perpendicular from the origin in a positive x direction. Each subsequent layer is extended in the minus z direction. Note for slopes to allign properly blocks with a height of 1 must be used
